`APIRoute.get_route_handler()` returns the coroutine function produced by `get_request_handler(...)` (a `Callable[[Request], Coroutine[Any, Any, Response]]`), as seen in `fastapi/routing.py`.

This returned handler is then wrapped by `request_response(...)` (from Starlette) when building `self.app = request_response(self.get_route_handler())` in `APIRoute.__init__` (`fastapi/routing.py`, line 1223), converting the async request handler into an ASGI application.
